messages:
Samir Patel: Quick one — Northbridge Health is asking for net90 + split annual invoicing for a 3yr commit. POC done, security ok, SOW $360,000 total (3yr). They want 30% upfront, then quarterly invoices. Can we get deal desk signoff?
Jules Bryant: Need details — what's the ARR-equivalent and discount if we do net90?
Samir Patel: It's effectively $120k/yr. We offered a 10% commit discount already (rate card applied). They want net90 to help cashflow. Sales wants 9mo pacing: 30% upfront, 40% year1 spread (quarterly), 30% at renewal. They asked to avoid annual upfront due to internal procurement timing.
Maya Chen: Finance here — net90 on a new account of this size triggers credit review. Also we usually require 25% upfront for multi-year commits. Any previous relationship/PO?
Samir Patel: No prior paid relationship. PO expected, but procurement said they can only do net90 terms. They can do a signed SOW and PO but payment timelines will be stretched.
Priya Rao: Legal — we'll need SOW amendment to reflect payment schedule and default remittance clauses. Also need to add interest on late payments if >30 days past terms.
Jules Bryant: Deal desk lean: We can approve net90 conditionally if Finance gets external credit verification + Invoices Bot to set invoice reminders + require first invoice paid within 45 days or ramped security deposit of $25k. Thoughts?
Elena Torres: From AM — risk of churn if we require 25% upfront. Can we split deposit into two smaller ones to ease procurement? E.g., $15k deposit + $10k holdback until month 3.
Maya Chen: Credit check cost + timeline? If vendor credit vendor returns within 3 business days, fine. Approve with 2 conditions: (1) $25k security deposit split allowed; (2) PO + signed SOW before billing. Otherwise default to 30% upfront.
Samir Patel: That works. I'll update SOW draft and ask procurement for PO. Can Deal Desk stamp approval text for SOW?
Jules Bryant: I'll post the approval blurb for the SOW — include clauses for deposit, net90, interest on late payments, and automatic rollover on commit. Use language: 'Customer granted net90 subject to $25,000 deposit (may be split into two payments), completed credit review, signed PO and SOW. Failure to pay first invoice by day 45 converts terms to 30% upfront.'
Invoices Bot: Invoice rule created: 'northbridge-health — conditional_net90 — deposit 25000 — trigger credit_check'.
Samir Patel: Thanks team — I'll attach the SOW in this thread when ready and flag Legal for final redlines. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: Ping me when SOW is here. I'll aim to finish redlines same day.
Jules Bryant: Approved in deal desk thread. Please link to legal + finance comments.
Samir Patel: Linking here — https://drive.redwood/northbridge/sow-v2 (will upload final).
